title: Etak Navigator Tour & Demo
summary: Raw 1991 home footage of a working Etak Navigator, the 1985 in-car navigation system that predated consumer GPS. It shows the system's cassette-based map display and explains its augmented dead reckoning using wheel sensors.
why: Cited as a rare look at how pre-GPS car navigation worked, especially its dead reckoning with turn-based recalibration.

quote.text: it looked almost like having a Vectrex in your car that ran maps off a standard cassette tape.
